real_yield_dataset.series_name: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis, Inflation-Indexed
real_yield_dataset.provider: FRED (U.S. Treasury / Board of Governors via FRED)
real_yield_dataset.release_cadence: Daily Treasury constant-maturity TIPS yield; typically available same day or next business day via FRED.

point_in_time_safety.alignment: Daily real-yield levels as-of joined to Friday NG weeks (last observation on or before week date). Transforms use only past weekly as-of levels — no full-sample z-score. YoY uses absolute pp change (safe when yields cross zero).

real_yield_dataset.revisions_policy: Treasury constant-maturity yields via FRED are market quotes; material delayed revision risk is low. Research treats downloaded daily values as point-in-time as-of.

alignment_with_ng_history.note: Daily DFII10 covers the post-2016 NG weekly valuation panel. Safe to align with storage + production YoY history via as-of join.

real_yield_dataset.economic_rationale: Higher 10Y real yields raise the opportunity cost of holding commodities and often coincide with tighter financial conditions, so the coefficient on log(NG price) should be negative.
